sentence_of_record: ARCH-V2 G22 / G23 READY legs, record runs at 4381e4b, independently reproduced (post-run review 2026-09-24). G23: identity HELD (tables sha256 04754dbc…, byte-identical, re-run and recomputed). Certificate B is ADMISSIBLE on both draws (utility 69.2% / 69.3%, LOAO wrong(established) 1 ≤ A's 1). P1, P2 and P3 HELD (cross-draw Jaccard 0.941 / 0.938). Holm: 809 → 736 per anchor → 671 pooled; the 19 ordered edges that lose establishment are all right-direction. MC-UNRESOLVED 22 of 920. G22 v1 validity FAILED as registered: the fresh-judge (random) mode puts f_raw_wrong at median 222.5 (central 0.99643 interval [43.9, 468.7]) against 7, and f_loao_called at median 6 [0, 384.9] against 667, with no replicate of 1,000 reaching either target (u likewise). The falsifier (a) FIRED: the registered simulator decides nothing. Design readings can re-enter only through the POST-HOC-SPECIFIED one-shot v2 (ruling 1 (ii)). P1 FAILED; P2 FAILED (merged exponent 1.88-2.02, CIs [1.78, 2.16], against 1.06 [0.80, 1.30]; the grok arm was not run); P3-P5 NOT SCORED (gated); P6 FAILED (2 of 14 anchors at D_c ≥ 0.95). P7 HELD under the post-data ruling of 97f3a1f: Meta-Llama-3_1-70B-Instruct is the unique top among merged's 4 called wrong(established) edges; the roster clause is OK on all three boards. Under the pre-data reading 'unique top on every board' it is NOT HELD (x12 and grok are one-edge ties). Merged wrong(established) overdispersion: by model χ² 53.40 on 20 models, p ≤ 0.0005 (0 of 2,000 permutations; within-anchor null p 0.0001); by anchor χ² 22.34, p 0.0465 ± 0.005 (Monte Carlo); DEFF 1.780 (ICC 0.0050, Kish m 158.3). [run 5abb79f (record runs from main at 4381e4b = ca84e44; zero judge calls), review 3ed7cbd (5 ACCEPT, 5 ACCEPT WITH; none rejected); denominators: grok 891 f / 920 u edges, 809 established, 2,811 judged questions in 14 anchors; merged 21,536 valid verdicts, 2,538 edges; R = 1,000 per validity mode; pool p2dca21ab5f4ef3ae, id-disjoint only; P7 scored under the POST-DATA ruling of 97f3a1f; the v2 one shot (e644a25) is NOT covered here]

plain_description.what: A replay of recorded judge data through the new version-2 code (no new calls). It checks that the code reproduces the old tables of pairwise model wins byte for byte. It also checks whether a new certificate rule (B) for declaring one model better than another is acceptable in place of the old rule (A).
plain_description.why: Before trusting the new pipeline, it must reproduce the old results, and the new certificate must not certify more wrong orderings.
plain_description.information: Exact reproduction plus an acceptable rule B would let version 2 replace version 1 safely. Result: reproduction held exactly. Rule B was acceptable on both data draws (it keeps about 69% of comparisons, with no more wrong 'established' orderings than A). The ranking was stable across draws. A companion simulator meant to predict error rates failed its own validity check and decides nothing. The certificate reading rests on older judged data and is now treated as an imported quantity, not fresh evidence.
